item.description:
⚡ Codex business and credit accounts read correctly, and Copilot stops dropping out.

✨ New

  • 🌊 The panel and the hover card ease between sizes when you switch providers, instead of jumping.

🔧 Fixed

  • 💳 Codex accounts metered in credits (business, enterprise) no longer fail with "Could not read Codex's usage panel", and the
    credit budget stays on screen while you work.
  • 🔑 Copilot reads its quota when Token Pacer is opened from Finder, not only from a terminal.
  • 📊 Copilot no longer shows 0% used right after a read, and no longer squeezes a month of usage into a five-hour split.
  • 📐 The pinned panel fits its content: no empty space under a quiet provider, and no clipped heatmap or square corners on a busy
    one.
  • 🧹 A failed reading still says why after a relaunch, and screenshots of the panel no longer come with a transparent border.

💬 Tell me what breaks: https://tokenpacer.com/#feedback
